title: Did rail networks catch up with urban expansion? Cohort-based standardized accessibility gaps across the mainland Greater Bay Area, 2018-2024

inference.group_weighting: mean eligible cells within city, then equal city weights

network.denominator: exhaustive official nine-city mother table independent of OSM availability
network.eligible: officially operational public urban metro, light rail and monorail; Guangdong intercity only from the first instant all frozen urban-style criteria are jointly met
network.excluded: national-rail passenger services that do not jointly meet the frozen urban-style criteria, high-speed/conventional long-distance, freight, private/internal systems, depots, construction and planned lines

eligible_if_all: service is operated by a provincial or municipal government-controlled urban-rail operator rather than the national-rail passenger operator
at least one non-reserved local AFC card or QR gate channel is available independently of train-specific advance reservation
urban_style_intercity_rule.activation_time: first official service instant when all three criteria are jointly satisfied; an earlier infrastructure opening or national-rail service date is not reused
urban_style_intercity_rule.adjudication_timing: frozen outcome-blind before any D outcome access

missing_eligible_component_triggers: required official opening or closure date missing
connected passenger-service topology cannot be reconstructed

missing_eligible_component_rule.development: failure in any D city stops all confirmatory outcome access
missing_eligible_component_rule.holdout_east: failure in any H1 city prevents the six-city holdout and nine-city conclusions
missing_eligible_component_rule.holdout_west: failure in any H2 city prevents the six-city holdout and nine-city conclusions
missing_eligible_component_rule.rescue_prohibited: H1 or H2 results cannot rehabilitate a mutated or gate-failed D analysis

imputation.transfer_walk: median direct verified pair in predeclared urban-urban or urban-intercity stratum; receiving half-headway added separately

accessibility.confirmatory_proxy: WorldPop 2023 native approximately 1 km population mass
accessibility.origin: accepted patch area-weighted centroid, snap <=250 m; exclude cell if unsupported converted area >20%
accessibility.path: minimum generalized time; ties within one second not double-counted

primary.cell: signed mean annual standardized matched-control gap D_i^s
primary.group: theta(S)=mean over cities of mean D_i^s over eligible cells

threshold_calibration.strata: development city x quintile distance to frozen 2017 built centroid

allocation.extra_rule: one extra cell to each of the five strata with the smallest sha256(city|quintile|20260826)
allocation.short_stratum: calibration gate failure; no cross-stratum reallocation

admission_conditions: JRC GSW valid coverage is at least 99% and permanent-water pixels occupy no more than 20% of cell area inside the AOI
pseudo-origin passes the frozen pedestrian-node snap rule
threshold_calibration.pseudo_controls: same frozen mature-control matcher, exclude pseudo-origin
threshold_calibration.reference: official-map geometry + official dates + primary timetable + nearest pedestrian snap

variants.definition: OSM geometry with the same official dates and primary timetable
reference geometry with qualifying secondary timetable values
variants.station_sequence: must be identical to the primary timetable
variants.value_agreement: secondary headway and runtime must each differ by no more than 10% from primary values

variants.definition: reference geometry with the second-nearest pedestrian node only when extra network distance is no more than 50 m

threshold_calibration.error: e_pr=abs(mean_t G_ptr under Rr - mean_t G_ptr under R0)
frozen_artifacts: 200 calibration cell identifiers and their 15 strata
R0, R1, R2 and R3 configuration files
threshold_calibration.perturbation_policy: only the three predeclared deterministic variants are allowed; random or post-result perturbations are prohibited

decision.positive: theta nine>=delta_sub; nine 95% lower>0; D/H1/H2 positive; six-city holdout 95% lower>0

opening_order: freeze nine-city mother table, imputation tables, calibration files, land rules, thresholds, code/config and hashes
open D once and archive all results
compute six-city and nine-city estimands mechanically
mutation_rule: any post-D rule change demotes D and combined estimands to exploratory; H1 or H2 cannot rehabilitate the mutated D analysis
